data.body:
[P1] Reconcile deferred requests before releasing the lease

Requiring an independent snapshot does not ensure that it covers `collection.deferredServiceRequests`. A snapshot containing only the original completed invocations passes `validate_retirement_evidence()`, and `_cleanup_record_errors()` never reads the deferred inventory. Consequently, an omitted service-only retry can leave `physical_retirement_verified` true and permit target reuse without proven quiescence. The later `audit_cutoff()` finding arrives after scheduling. Before releasing the lease, require every deferred request to have a matching completed invocation or supported `UNDISPATCHED` settlement in the audited snapshot; add a regression where the supplied snapshot omits that request.
